DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID).

The negative workup for urinary tract infection and normal ultrasound make a simple UTI or appendicitis less likely. Given your history of dyspareunia, dysuria, nausea, vomiting, and recent unprotected sex, these findings are highly suggestive of an ascending infection of the upper reproductive tract. Have you been treated with any antibiotics recently, and do you have a history of chlamydia or gonorrhea?
